title: LandRole
description: A party holds a role over a parcel for a period, supported by evidence. This is where farmer, landowner and land controller are distinguished.

parcelId.description: BLOCKED: forests.parcels does not exist (GEO-001 has no tables). This reference cannot be enforced by a foreign key until it does.

role.description: farmer: works the land. landowner: holds title in a formal registry. land_controller: holds authority to commit the land without formal title — customary authority, cooperative, council, concession or attorney. One party may hold several roles over the same parcel.

authorityBasis.description: Required when role is land_controller: on what basis authority is held. OPEN QUESTION 1 — customary authority, cooperative, concession and power of attorney are legally distinct and may deserve separate roles rather than a free-text field.

conveysAuthorityToCommit.description: Derived, stored for auditability: true for landowner and land_controller, false for farmer. LAND-002 requires at least one party with this true before conservation may be committed on a parcel.

exclusive.description: Whether this role claims to exclude others of the same role for the period. Overlapping non-exclusive claims are permitted so genuine disputes can be recorded rather than silently resolved at capture time.

supportingEvidence.description: Title deed, customary attestation, tenancy agreement, community minute. Referenced, never embedded (EVID-001/002).

assertedBy.description: The actor who recorded this claim. A role is asserted by staff, not proven by the system.
